scoring_justification: Absolute binding energies and frequency shifts depend strongly on the functional and basis set; the paper's proprietary CRYSTAL code and exact basis contractions cannot be reproduced exactly with an open-source code. Therefore we grade the robust physical trends: relative ordering of binding energies (Li > Na > H > K) and CO frequency shifts (Li > H > Na > K), and positivity of all BSSE-corrected binding energies.

outputs.description: BSSE-corrected CO binding energies and hypsochromic CO stretching frequency shifts for H⁺, Li⁺, Na⁺, and K⁺ exchanged chabazite. The checker verifies the ordering relationships and positivity, not absolute values.

output_contract.notes: Scoring uses structural audit: check that Li_BE_n > Na_BE_n > H_BE_n > K_BE_n and Li_delta_nu > H_delta_nu > Na_delta_nu > K_delta_nu, and that all BEⁿ are > 0. Absolute values may vary with basis set/implementation.

steps.description: Structural check: positivity of BEⁿ, BEⁿ ordering Li > Na > H > K, Δν ordering Li > H > Na > K.
